COPILOT.TITLE: {product} copilot
COPILOT.AI_DRAFT_HINT: Written by {product}. Nothing is sent until you send it.
COPILOT.USE_REPLY_HINT: Puts the draft in your composer to review before you send.
COPILOT.COPY_REPLY_HINT: This inbox is listen-only: paste the draft into the tool you reply from.
COPILOT.COPY_FAILED: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

BRIEFING.HOT_LEADS: {n} hot lead waiting | {n} hot leads waiting
BRIEFING.EMPTY: No urgent leads right now. {product} will flag the moment a hot one comes in.

NOW.waiting: waiting for a reply | waiting for a reply
NOW.due_today: follow-up due today | follow-ups due today

AI_HINT.OFF: The AI is off for this workspace (or its kill switch is on). Nothing is drafted.
AI_HINT.SHADOW: The AI drafts replies as private notes only. Nothing is sent to customers.
AI_HINT.LIVE: At least one inbox lets the AI reply to customers.
AI_HINT.UNKNOWN: The AI service did not answer just now. This is checked again every minute.

STARTERS.ADDED: Added {n} starter replies. Edit them to sound like you.
STARTERS.FAILED: Could not add the starter replies. Try again.

COLLISION.TEXT: {name} replied to this customer while you were writing. Read it before you send?

REPLY_CLOSED.TITLE: Reply window closed.
REPLY_CLOSED.META_24_HOURS: The customer last wrote more than 24 hours ago. You can reply again as soon as they send a new message.
REPLY_CLOSED.META_7_DAYS: The customer last wrote more than 7 days ago, past Meta's human-agent limit. You can reply again as soon as they send a new message.
REPLY_CLOSED.WHATSAPP: The customer last wrote more than 24 hours ago. Send an approved template to start again, or wait for their next message.
REPLY_CLOSED.TIKTOK: The customer last wrote more than 48 hours ago. You can reply again as soon as they send a new message.
REPLY_CLOSED.API_HOURS: This inbox only allows replies within {hours} hours of the customer's last message.
REPLY_CLOSED.OTHER: This channel doesn't allow a reply right now. You can reply again when the customer writes.

REPLY_WINDOW.HUMAN_AGENT: Human-agent window: {left} left (your replies only, never the AI)
REPLY_WINDOW.SENT_TAGGED: Sent with Meta's Human Agent tag · {name}
REPLY_WINDOW.AUDIT_HINT: Every Messenger and Instagram reply sent with Meta's Human Agent tag: when, by whom and in which conversation. Only people send these, never the AI.
REPLY_WINDOW.AUDIT_EMPTY: No reply has used the Human Agent tag.

CARD.AI_DRAFTED_HINT: {product} drafted a reply for you to review.
